description.text: The other BW5 expansion, released on 16 March 2012 alongside Dragon Blast with more Dragon-type cards after the type's debut in Dragon Selection. Garchomp, now a Dragon, leads it on the wrapper with its speed, and its Pokémon-EX are Rayquaza-EX, Ho-Oh-EX and Registeel-EX. Its theme is the Pokémon League, and it was made to pair with the Garchomp Deck 30 half deck released the same day. The cards are numbered to 50. In English it became part of Dragons Exalted in August 2012, together with Dragon Blast.
